items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Hal Proctor was the fellow that lived up the street from me.

ctx.x: But I don't know if I ever mentioned that to you before, Jim. Well, Hal Proctor was the fellow that lived up the street from me. Oh, he was probably 15 or 20 years older than I me, and he played saxophone. Now after my trying to play I had... now, I had had some piano lessons from my mother and then subsequently from my older sister, and then subsequently some more lessons from the teacher who had been teaching her.
I didn't have the ... all together, this was probably about a year of piano study, after which I decided that I really didn't want to play piano; I wanted to play ...
